name: Uesugi Kazumi
source: Class rep for Haunted Hoax. He’s knowledgeable about school events, resourceful, and a reliable ally, but he’s so head over heels for Shiina that his good sides aren’t very evident. Only the powers above know if she’ll ever notice his feelings.
